adversarial_probes.what: Hash-chain integrity AFTER encoder-produced rows are inserted into audit_event. Uses live isolated Postgres (55479). Inserts a grant.create row with specific prev_hash/row_hash values, verifies columns are preserved, then confirms the T-0016 UPDATE-blocking trigger still fires on grant-family rows.
adversarial_probes.expected: Chain columns preserved on INSERT; UPDATE blocked by trigger (append-only invariant holds regardless of event type).
adversarial_probes.result: PASS — INSERT OK, prev_hash=deadbeef/row_hash=cafebabe preserved, UPDATE on actor blocked (trigger throws). Adversarial unit probes: (а-1) no chain columns in any encoder output (5 grant + 2 assignment events); (а-2) JSON.stringify roundtrip clean (no Buffer/circular); (а-3) occurred_at is integer ≤ 2^53; (а-4) id is non-empty string.

adversarial_probes.what: Encoder with garbage GrantAuditEvent (missing required fields, unknown kind) — fail-closed vs silent corruption. Tests: (б-1) missing actor → undefined/null actor (not fabricated string); (б-2) empty {} → no valid type; (б-3) unknown kind passes through literally (not silently mapped to known type); (б-4) AssignmentAuditEvent missing employeeId → undefined subject.
adversarial_probes.expected: Encoder either throws (fail-closed) or passes the invalid value through faithfully so the DB NOT NULL constraint or type validation rejects it. Must NOT silently substitute a fake actor/type string.
adversarial_probes.result: PASS — (б-1): actor=undefined (not 'unknown'/'system'); (б-2): type=undefined (not 'grant.create'); (б-3): unknown kind 'grant.unknown-future-type' passed through literally, not silently changed; (б-4): subject=undefined (not fabricated). All 4 tests green.

adversarial_probes.what: HTTP /api/grant-trail with edge-case invalid params: limit=0, limit=-1, limit=501, limit=1.5, before_seq=abc, before_seq=-5. Must all return 400 INVALID_PARAM, not 500/empty 200.
adversarial_probes.result: PASS — all 6 return 400 INVALID_PARAM. No 500 produced. Supplements existing AC-16/17 coverage.

adversarial_probes.what: Tenant header substitution: X-Dev-User = random UUID, SQL injection string, empty string → route must not 500 or leak cross-tenant data. Live DB: queryGrantTrail with non-UUID tenantId (SQL injection, 'not-a-uuid', empty, short UUID) → assertUuid must throw before any DB query.
adversarial_probes.expected: HTTP layer: 200 with seed data for all X-Dev-User values (static path). DB layer: assertUuid blocks non-UUID tenantId with clear error.
adversarial_probes.result: PASS — HTTP probes (г-1/г-2/г-3): all return 200 with seed data, no 500, no exception. Live DB probe: all 4 bad tenantIds rejected by assertUuid ('tenantId must be a valid UUID') before any DB query executes — SQL injection impossible via this path.

adversarial_probes.what: UI fallback honesty: when DATABASE_URL absent, TRAIL_SEED is served transparently (not masking a DB error). Response must have: ≥1 row, hasMore=false for default limit=100 (10 seed rows < 100), correct GrantTrailRow shape with valid types, no 'is_seed'/'error' fields in response.
adversarial_probes.expected: 200 with 10 TRAIL_SEED rows, hasMore=false, all rows have type ∈ {grant-family types}, no error/is_seed marker.
adversarial_probes.result: PASS — (д-1): 200 + 10 rows; (д-2): hasMore=false; (д-3): all rows have type/actor/seq/occurred_at as correct types, all types ∈ valid grant-family set; (д-4): no error/is_seed/seed_fallback field in response. TRAIL_SEED is transparent fallback, not error-masking.

false_fail_discipline.observed: Initial fitness:db run with DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:testpass@localhost:55479/choros_test failed schema.test.ts (1/277): 'every tenant table is owned by choros_migrator, not choros_app' — owner was 'postgres'.
false_fail_discipline.diagnosis: tooling-gap: isolated container has no choros_migrator role; migrations ran as postgres superuser so tables owned by postgres. Fix: CREATE ROLE choros_migrator SUPERUSER LOGIN, recreate DB with OWNER choros_migrator, re-run migrations. Product DDL is correct — migration 001 creates choros_app but relies on the container bootstrap superuser being choros_migrator (documented in run.mjs comments). Correct harness setup resolves the issue cleanly. Not a product defect.
false_fail_discipline.root_class: tooling-gap (tester harness: wrong DB user in initial setup); resolved by using choros_migrator URL
